deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this junction to improve safety for pedestrians crossing the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a two-lane road.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to improve accessibility for pedestrians and wheelchair users.
Install street lighting along the left side of the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers.
Install street lighting along the right side of the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a formal footway, though there is a dirt shoulder.
The right side has some paved areas in front of shops but lacks a continuous, dedicated footway.
No specific junction or crossing demand is clearly visible in the frames to justify a signalised crossing.
No crossing facility is present to evaluate the need for a refuge island.
No crossing facility is present to evaluate the need for kerb ramps.
There is a lack of consistent street lighting on the left side.
There is a lack of consistent street lighting on the right side.
